title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
title_zh: 重新思考水下图像增强：通过文本引导的退化课程学习

paragraphs.en: 提出文本引导退化课程学习框架，利用扩散模型合成退化样本提升水下图像增强泛化能力。 Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 提出文本引导退化课程学习框架，利用扩散模型合成退化样本提升水下图像增强泛化能力。现有成对的清晰-退化数据集推动了基于学习的水下图像增强的发展，但这些数据集要么规模有限，要么难以获取，仍无法充分覆盖真实水下环境中遇到的多样退化。 如此稀缺且不足的数据最终限制了水下图像增强模型的泛化能力，凸显了对真实且可控的退化建模的需求，以便更好地捕捉真实水下条件并提升增强的鲁棒性。 为此，我们针对水下图像增强任务提出一个统一的退化感知训练框架。 文本条件退化增强流水线利用文本引导的扩散模型合成多样且语义一致的退化样本，提供成对数据以支持后续的课程学习策略。 所提出的渐进退化课程在多个属性和难度层级上组织训练以促进均衡学习，而透射率引导的单步扩散模型则利用这一渐进过程，更好地应对水下图像中退化程度的广泛范围和复原的模糊性。 在多个水下基准上的大量实验表明，我们提出的方法取得了优越的性能。 我们的代码和模型将随本工作发表后发布。
